name: Ember Pepper
description: Hot enough to toast bread. Do not keep it in a back pocket.

name: Frost Mint
description: So cooling that sniffing it counts as a short holiday.

name: Sunpetal
description: Turns towards whoever is talking. Mends things. Likes compliments.

name: Nightshade Cap
description: A mushroom that sighs when picked. Brings sleep and the spooky sort of dark.

name: Honeycomb
description: A little warmth, a lot of healing. The bees would like a receipt.

name: Moonmoss
description: Grows on north-facing gravestones, tough as old boots. Grind it: a touch of calm, a lot of spooky.
